SEALED_BEFORE_APPLICATION.statement: this artifact is sealed BEFORE the floor is applied to any claim. k is a RESULT, never a target.

HARD_FLOORS.rule: SEARCHABLE_SUPPORT = evaluable_pairs >= 10,000 AND positive_pairs >= 100 AND positive_securities >= 30

RATIONALE.EVALUABLE_MIN_10000: a baseline measurability guard. The observed minimum is already 19,783, so this floor cuts essentially nothing — which is correct, because the census showed LOW EVALUABILITY is not this family's real problem.
RATIONALE.POSITIVE_MIN_100: yields a claim built on a genuinely repeating X-state rather than a handful of instances. This is a SUPPORT ADEQUACY threshold, NOT a significance or power threshold.
RATIONALE.POSITIVE_SECURITY_MIN_30: the most important breadth guard. A claim with 500 occurrences on 3 tickers is not the same quality of candidate as 500 on 150 tickers. 30 is also a sane minimum for downstream clustered inference not to rest on a few names.
RATIONALE.epistemic_status: these are PRE-Y DESIGN THRESHOLDS setting minimum episode count and cross-security breadth. They are NOT a statistical theorem and NOT an optimal cut.

NO_TYPE_SPECIFIC_FLOOR.decision: one claim grammar -> ONE support standard
NO_TYPE_SPECIFIC_FLOOR.why_uniform_anyway: type-specific floors would grant different admission standards to different parts of the family purely because their support distributions differ
NO_TYPE_SPECIFIC_FLOOR.accepted_consequence: a large share of boolean->boolean claims may fail. That is not bias against them — their X-state combinations are simply often sparse.

NO_POSITION_SPECIFIC_FLOOR.decision: identical thresholds on M1->M2, M2->M3, M3->M4
NO_POSITION_SPECIFIC_FLOOR.basis: the census showed no position suffers structural starvation (median positive 71 / 60 / 63)

CONCENTRATION_POLICY.status_rule: if securities_positive <= 48 -> DEGENERATE (metric reaches 1.0 by construction); else INFORMATIVE
CONCENTRATION_POLICY.explicit: concentration NEVER affects searchability in V1

MULTI_REASON_EXCLUSION.rule: record all three tests independently per claim
MULTI_REASON_EXCLUSION.FORBIDDEN: precedence ordering where the first failure hides the others

ZERO_POSITIVE_CLAIMS.retention: NOT deleted from the census or registry; recorded with excluded_reason

HOLDOUT_NON_EXCLUSION.evidence: 51.8% of claims never fire in the 12 HOLDOUT sessions and the median claim has zero HOLDOUT positives; a HOLDOUT floor would cut half the family on timing luck

IRREVERSIBILITY_CLAUSE.rule: apply ONCE to all 45,387 claims; k is whatever results
IRREVERSIBILITY_CLAUSE.explicit: if k is 300, or 2,000, or 20,000, that is the answer
IRREVERSIBILITY_CLAUSE.FORBIDDEN: revising the floor because the surviving count seems too large or too small
IRREVERSIBILITY_CLAUSE.reason: that would be post-hoc multiplicity engineering
